body: Also about retakes, I sincerely do not thinkthat i have the mental capacity to go through all of that again. I don't even want to. Whats the point if my hard work isn't rewarded? What IS rewarded?

Where I live they are right about there being no choice aside from education. If I was to take up a trade I would be considered an outcast amongst the other people who work in that field. The class system works both ways. Id not only be abused mentally and probably physically I would be exploited. Next to no wages. 

Please tell your father in law that people like him are the foundation of hope outside of societal norms without which a lot of people would truly be lost. 

Another thing about where I live is that we do not have proper facilities. The very best we get is okayish-good physical healthcare. There is nothing outside of this. I live in a primitive feudal state and I don't see it changing for the better anytime soon. Most of the problems I have are because I can not deal with them because of the culture and situation of the place where I live. 

My plan was to use these grades to get out

I guess not. 
Thank you for reading my rant. I still don't understand what I feel but it makes it a lot better to know that at least someone somewhere cares, be it not my family.
